cards.description: The approved frost, snowfall and cold mist around the still knight.
Cold light travels through the painted ice as snow and mist drift.
Red plume and cloth stir; warm dust and metal glints move around the fixed warrior.
Golden painted dust flows while the rook’s banner catches the wind.
Ribbon tips, wind and leaves move around the suspended bishop.
Warm light and fine ivory dust gather in the pawn shell around the revealed rook.
Standards stir and dusty air rolls above the marching scene.
A light leaf-and-mist gust follows the leap; the stag stays still.
Turquoise spirit mist rises from the dead world toward the ivory rook.
Painted glass wisps and faint frost light move behind the mirror surface; hands and cards stay steady.
Living painted fire and embers protect the still ivory army.
Dust and loose chips drift around the frozen shockwave.
The painted fire wake and embers shimmer; the clash stays still.
Red-gold fire travels through the existing wake at the enemy’s fortress.
Translucent teal breath flows between the friendly rook and knight.
The crimson banner and streamers flutter while two separate dust wakes stir around the allies.
Lilac light and ivory flecks breathe around the carved transformation.
Prominent painted clouds drift in moonlight around the steady figure and shadow.
Leaves and loose painted debris catch the wind around Hop’s leap.
Purple painted wisps curl around the still ebony knight.
Visible painted rocks rise through cloud and wind around both towers.
Painted water ripples, lake mist and frost move around the steady rescue clasp.
A gentle source-gold sheen travels through the crown and painted ornament.
